samples.question: A reference glyph is drawn in the top panel: an outline frame that is either a circle or a square, containing one central bar that is either horizontal or vertical. Below, the image is split into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), each holding one larger glyph with the same two features: an outline frame (circle or square) and a central bar (horizontal or vertical). Exactly one quadrant's glyph matches the reference on BOTH features: the same frame shape AND the same bar orientation. The other three glyphs each differ from the reference on at least one feature. Which quadrant contains the one glyph that matches the reference on both features?
